Petitioner has approached this Court seeking a relief to direct the 7th respondent to disburse the compensation towards the structural value as per Ext.P10, forthwith.

2. A counter affidavit has been filed by the 7 th respondent, wherein it is admitted that the land was taken possession on 13.12.2021, and on 15.12.2021 the same was handed over to the requisitioning authority.

Since the petitioner society has failed to produce prior documents, the award was passed in this case deferring the compensation awarded in the joint account of the Competent Authority and Project Director, NHAI pending the production of the required documents.

3. Petitioner relying on Section 3H(4) of the National Highway Act, 1956, submits that, if any dispute arises as to the apportionment of the amount or any part thereof or to any person to whom the same or any part thereof is payable, competent authority shall refer the dispute to the decision of the Principal Civil Court of original jurisdiction within the limits of whose jurisdiction the land is situated.

The manner of deposit of the award amount is also specified in the National Highway (Manner of Depositing of The Amount by the Central Government Making Requisite Funds Available to the Competent Authority for Acquisition of Land) Rules, 2019 (herein after referred to as the Rules, 2019), wherein Rule 4 reads as follows.
